{{Top|leg}}
The '''energy prod''' was a tool used for intimidation and [[Torture/Legends|torture]]. It was utilized by both the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Corporate Sector Authority/Legends|Corporate Sector Authority]] to coerce information out of [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoners]].<ref name="EGWT">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref>
